claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SC-9 is a naphthalenesulfonamide PKC activator that inhibits glioma proliferation, but at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled screen it is expected to be largely inactive because its growth-inhibitory effects require sustained PKC activation and are not broadly cytotoxic.
